caption: A warm loaf fresh from the oven is slid into a clear plastic bag, and the inside of the bag fogs over.

sa.check: A warm loaf is slid into a clear plastic bag.
The inside of the bag fogs over.
The fog is thickest above the loaf.
The outside of the bag stays dry.
The loaf goes in first and the fogging follows.

pc.expect: The fog appears on the bag's inner face once the warm loaf is inside and is thickest above it.
pc.fail: The bag is fogged before the loaf is in it; or the loaf sits in the bag and the plastic stays clear and dry to the end of the clip; or the fog appears on the outside of the bag; or the fog is thickest at a corner far from the loaf.

pc.expect: The fog only thickens while the warm loaf stays in the bag and gathers into drops; it does not clear on its own.
pc.fail: The fog clears while the warm loaf stays in the closed bag; or the fog thins and thickens in turn; or the drops draw back into a clear film and the bag dries; or the fog moves to the outer face as it thickens.

pc.expect: Drops on the bag's inner face run downward and pool at its bottom, and drops on the upper face hang and fall.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the bag's inner face; or drops fall upward off the upper face; or water gathers along the bag's top and stays as a dome; or drops hang in the air inside the bag away from the plastic.

pc.expect: The bag is a limp clear film that creases and clings and the fog beads on it, and the loaf stays a soft solid.
pc.fail: The bag stays a rigid box as the loaf goes in; or the bag's film sets hard as it fogs; or the loaf flows as a liquid in the bag; or the fog stands off the film as a thick crust.

pc.expect: One loaf in one bag; the loaf stays whole inside and nothing passes through the plastic.
pc.fail: The loaf passes out through the bag's wall; or a second loaf appears; or the loaf vanishes; or the bag splits into two bags.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bag's printing, the loaf's crust and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The bag's printing changes; or the crust changes pattern; or items on the counter rearrange.

note: Who bags the loaf is not judged.
